editorial:
Imagine your phone becoming a doorway for something evil. That is exactly what happens to a struggling teen girl in this flick. You get to follow her parents, who do not believe in God, as they watch their daughter change into something scary and mean. The vibe is very tense and creepy, making you feel like something is always watching from the screen. It takes a familiar setup and adds a modern twist by using technology as the trigger for the possession, which makes the horror feel a bit more real for anyone who cannot put their phone down.

You will probably love the acting, as the girl does a great job playing both a scared kid and a demon. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the scary scenes really pack a punch. If you like movies about exorcisms and dark secrets, you should definitely check this one out. It looks great if you can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move so you can watch it whenever you want.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the Catholic priest performs a risky exorcism to save the girl. There is a big fight between the priest and the demon, but the parents finally put aside their doubts to help. The evil spirit is eventually forced out of the girl's body and sent back to hell. The family survives the night, and the movie ends with them finally finding peace and a new sense of faith after almost losing their daughter.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves possession movies and supernatural thrillers.
